comment: Upload PDF Payload for Chorus /deposer/pdf endpoint
description: This payload structure is sent when uploading a PDF invoice to Chorus Pro

fieldDescriptions.idUtilisateurCourant: Technical Chorus user identifier required by the PDF deposit API
fieldDescriptions.formatDepot: PDF format: 'PDF_NON_SIGNE' for unsigned, 'PDF_SIGNE' for digitally signed
fieldDescriptions.nomFichier: PDF filename with .pdf extension (used for reference and context)

notes: The technical user id must match the authenticated Chorus context used for submission
The fichierFacture field must be valid base64-encoded PDF binary content
Chorus will return a pieceJointeId in the response that must be referenced in the invoice submission
The returned pieceJointeId should be injected into pieceJointePrincipale[0].pieceJointePrincipaleId in the submission payload
formatDepot defaults to PDF_NON_SIGNE unless the PDF carries a digital signature
